_comment: Role fields not listed here are derived from RACI and workflows by registry_io.derive_role_contract.

permission_tiers.observe: Read-only access to repositories, evidence and telemetry. Writes only the role's own report artifacts.
permission_tiers.change-non-production: Scoped write to repositories and non-production environments for assigned artifacts. No production, IAM, secret or destructive authority.
permission_tiers.propose: Prepares plans, diffs and change requests for sensitive actions (production, IAM, secrets, security controls). Execution needs explicit human authorization.
